'''Maru''' were agile [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. They had muscular hind legs and a long tail, though their forearms were vestigial. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] inhabitants of Alaris Prime used the beasts as war mounts, equipping the maru with special saddles, dual [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], and a [[seismic pulse emitter]].

==Biology and appearance==
Maru were agile,<ref name="TUR" /> bipedal,<ref name="Prima" /> [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] beasts [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. Although their forearms were vestigial, they had muscular hind legs and could use their long tails for defense. The creatures were able to run long distances<ref name="TUR" /> and could maintain their speed while carrying a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] on their back. Maru had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin with pale underbellies.<ref name="Prima" />

==Behavior==
Maru were [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] creatures that mainly inhabited [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. They mostly [[Foodstuff/Legends|fed]] on smaller animals from the forest floor and held their prey with their small arms to devour it. Many wild maru roamed the woods in packs of six or more, though others were domesticated by the local Wookiee population.<ref name="Prima" />

==History==
One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], during which the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], to [[22 BBY|21.9 BBY]], or one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].</ref> the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] invaded Alaris Prime. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Separatists, had recently acquired the [[Force Harvester]] and planned to use it to power the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Having captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], Dooku intended to use the Jedi to test the Force Harvester, which drained the living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] from beings and converted it to energy. However, Skywalker escaped on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] with the help of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Bera Kazan]].<ref name="TCWgame">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maru were first mentioned in the [[2002]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', the [[Prima Games]] guide to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]],<ref name="Prima" /> which released that same year and was the creature's first appearance.<ref name="TCWgame" />
